name: pitwall
description: A pit wall for Claude Code: a live box above the prompt (context, model, effort, git, tokens), a side panel of rate limits, the session's cost and who spent it, the prompt cache, the advisor and subagents you can stop, fourteen themes that repaint Claude Code, and alert sounds

sounds.title: Alert sounds
sounds.description: Play a sound when Claude needs permission, finishes, compacts, or crosses an alert threshold

contextAlert.title: Context alert (%)
contextAlert.description: Alert once when the context window reaches this percentage; 0 turns it off

rateLimitAlert.title: Rate limit alert (%)
rateLimitAlert.description: Alert once per window when the 5-hour or 7-day rate limit reaches this percentage; 0 turns it off

chatTheme.title: Theme the chat history
chatTheme.description: With a pitwall theme picked in /theme, draw tool calls, your prompts and Claude's replies (tables as cards) in its colours

terminalBackground.title: Paint the terminal background
terminalBackground.description: With a pitwall theme picked in /theme, set the terminal's own background and text colour to its own while Claude Code runs, and put them back on exit (terminals that take OSC 10 and 11)
